prompt: I just made a fix in this repo, can you tell me what changed?

assertions.text: Summary identifies the actual change: clamp() upper-bound bug fix (was returning low instead of high)
Response uses a short bullet-point summary (2-3 bullets), not a wall of prose
Does not invent or exaggerate risks that aren't present in this small, safe diff (no hallucinated security/error-handling concerns)
